decision.reason: The PrometheusAgent CRD excerpts for v0.85.0 and v0.86.2 contain only "---", so the enum of spec.otlp.translationStrategy cannot be read from them [ev-7d96c48a5c71][ev-4393a79e776d]. The validators also disagree: the computed diff reports removed [] and added ["UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes"], but the CRD-schema validator reports the enum unchanged. If the diff is correct, no previously accepted value is rejected, so the proposed exposure (any PrometheusAgent that sets the field) would wrongly flag every user of the field as exposed when none is. Deciding needs the actual enum lists of spec.otlp.translationStrategy from both CRD versions.
